messages:
Sam C: Quick heads-up — prepping AcroHealth QBR (next Tue). Need a concise token-econ snapshot, 90-day spend forecast, and any onboarding blockers that could become a renewal risk. Can we triage today? @Liz P @Kai R @Maya G
Liz P: On it. Pulled the last 30d numbers — total tokens ~1.2M. Embeddings ~48%, chat gen ~52%. Current monthly run-rate ≈ $24k. If they enable the additional embed tests they mentioned, forecast jumps to ~$36k/mo. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/acrohealth
Kai R: Forecast export (quick):
profile: acrohealth; 30d_tokens: 1_200_000; current_mrr_est: $24,000; risk_scenario: embed_tests_enabled; risk_mrr_est: $36,000; notes: high embed ratio; cache-miss ~25% on top templates
Maya G: Onboarding blockers: SSO still pending from their side, docs for our SDK gaps (missing sample for streaming embed calls), and their eng lead is out till next Thu. That could delay ramp and make the higher spend not sustainable.
Sam C: Good context. Action items: 1) Liz — add a conservative throttle suggestion for embeddings in the QBR deck (e.g., cap concurrent embed jobs, enable prefix caching). 2) Kai — create a budget alert for $30k/mo and an automated notification path to the account team. 3) Maya — SSO ETA + enablement invites; capture any ask list. Can we aim EOD for items 1+2?
BillingBot: Alert created: AcroHealth monthly threshold set to $30,000. Notifying billing@acrohealth.com and ops-oncall. (alert id: ab-174550)
Liz P: Noted. Also found ~25% cache-miss on their top 3 prompts. Quick config we can flip: enable prefix KV cache for model-x-large and reduce kv-ttl from 5m to 2m for interactive flows — should reduce token spend ~8-12% in risk scenario. I'll add exact numbers to the deck.
Kai R: Budget alert + Slack/webhook done. I put a tiny runbook snippet in the ticket: /api/v1/accounts/acrohealth/alerts -d '{"threshold":30000,"notify":"#cs-acrohealth"}' — will follow up with PR to infra at 15:00 PST.
Maya G: SSO vendor confirmed: integration window Wed AM next week. I'll schedule two enablement sessions (dev + product) and send invites now. Also capturing docs gaps and assigning to docs-rotation.
Sam C: Awesome — if 1+2 are in by EOD we can include a conservative burn + mitigation plan in the QBR. If anything slips, flag it as a renewal-risk item. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Liz P: Will put the conservative and optimistic spend lines on slide 3. ETA 5pm.
